motive.canonical: Ben Carter discovered Isabella Reed had been stealing from the cafe till and gave her until this morning to confess before he took the proof to the village committee.

method.canonical: Blunt force with the Brass till weight, in the storage room.

opportunity.canonical: Isabella Reed was at the cafe's rear door during the murder window and lied about being at the fountain.

explanation: Correct. Isabella Reed killed Ben Carter. Ben Carter had found the torn ledger page proving Isabella Reed was skimming the till, and gave her until this morning to confess before taking it to the committee. He summoned her to the storage room before opening. Isabella Reed slipped out the front, doubled back through the rear alley — the blue coat Owen Price saw at 09:34 — and let herself in the back door. When Ben Carter refused to back down she struck him with the Brass till weight at 09:43 (the thud Owen Price and Marcus Bell heard), rinsed it in the kitchen and hid it in the mop bucket, then opened the cafe two minutes late. Her fountain alibi was never real, and no one could place her there.
